'''Yuru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] who was born during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. He lived in a [[Daimanate|region]] under the control of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] and four of his older siblings were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] while serving in Daiman's [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Army/Legends|armies]]. The company [[Industrial Heuristics]] later sent representatives to Daiman's holdings to search for teenagers to work aboard an [[arxeum]], and Yuru's father went to Eejor's job in his son's place, to allow Eejor to meet with the Industrial Heuristics representatives. Yuru was subsequently sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]], to serve aboard an arxeum that Daiman had acquired from the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] Sith Lord [[Ayanos Bactra]]. However, the arxeum was destroyed during the [[Battle of Gazzari]], and Yuru and the other children fled the planet with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]], aboard the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']].
